instruction.text: Fill in the gap by forming an adjective from the noun in bold.

atoms.b: Jeremy tries to make sure he eats a ((healthy)) and balanced diet.
From her desk, Josie could see all her friends having fun at the beach, which was very ((distracting)).
Surgeons must be very ((accurate)) when operating on a patient.
The more ((dense)) an object is, the faster it will sink.
Jasmine wished for her dreams to become ((real)).
In science class, Ben and Sophie were trying to find which solution was ((pure)) water.
Kalaya is very good at keeping things ((private)), so her friends can trust her with their secrets.

instruction.text: Write the best adjective from the list to fill in the gap.

atoms.b: As they walked into the deep, dark forest, an ((eery)) feeling began to settle in.
Since she started jogging regularly, Bessie has felt much ((healthier)).
Joshua has been the ((shortest)) in the class since their very first day at school.
Chloe was ((jealous)) of Amelia’s new laptop.
